event.description: "By Industry People, For Industry People" The Panel and Engineered Lumber International Conference and Expo (PELICE) is a premier educational event tailored for the global wood products industries, including segments such as veneer, plywood, OSB, MDF, particleboard, engineered wood products, mass timber, and value-added products. The 10th edition of PELICE took place at the Omni Atlanta Hotel at Centennial Park, drawing a remarkable attendance of 470 industry professionals, featuring 95 exhibitors and 41 speakers. The biennial conference, which first launched in 2008, serves as a crucial platform for industry stakeholders to gauge market trends and strategize for the future. Jim Salchenberg from Roseburg highlighted his company's significant capital investments in new facilities, demonstrating a proactive approach to navigating industry challenges while adhering to budgetary discipline. A recurring theme during the conference was the structural shift towards engineered wood products (EWP). Lofton Beasley from Weyerhaeuser articulated the enduring nature of this trend, which is driven by factors such as labor shortages, demand for efficiency, and rising reliance on prefabricated systems. Beasley underscored that EWP is central to the future strategy of the industry, backed by capacity expansion efforts to enhance product value. Market dynamics were further analyzed by Chris Beard from John Burns Research and Consulting, who noted the near-term pressures faced by new construction amidst an aging housing stock, which is catalyzing growth in repair and remodeling activities. Guillermo Velarde from AFRY Management Consulting provided insights into shifting materials and global pressures impacting the industry, underscoring the importance of operational efficiency and product diversification. PELICE remains committed to its mission of fostering knowledge sharing and addressing the challenges faced by the wood products industry. It continues to serve as a vital gathering for industry leaders to collaborate on innovative solutions and strategic investments. As PELICE celebrates its tenth anniversary, it reinforces its legacy as a cornerstone event for the panel and engineered wood products sector, providing attendees with valuable insights and a unified understanding of industry trends and developments.
